name: dunstan
description: Checks a coding agent's declared handback (head commit, changed files, tests, references, checks) against the pull request's own GitHub record before it says done. Deterministic: no model decides the verdict.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional, fine-grained, read-only)
github_token.description: A fine-grained personal access token with read-only permissions, limited to the repositories you check, with an expiry. Leave empty to read public repositories anonymously. Dunstan sends it only to GitHub's API.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token (optional, read_api, read-only)
gitlab_token.description: A GitLab personal, project or group access token with the read_api scope only, limited to the projects you check, with an expiry. Leave empty to read public projects anonymously; a tests claim on GitLab then stays unverifiable. Dunstan sends it only to the GitLab host a check names.
